fullContentHtml:
UP B.Ed. Result 2026 Out - Complete Details

Short Information : Bundelkhand University, BU Jhansi has released the result for the Uttar Pradesh B.Ed. Joint Entrance Examination 2026. Applications for the UP B.Ed. Online Form 2026 were accepted from 10 February 2026 to 30 April 2026. The written examination was held on 31 May 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their UP B.Ed. Result 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 10 February 2026
  • Last Date : 30 April 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 April 2026
  • With Late Fee Last Date : 5 May 2026
  • Form Correction Date : 6-10 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 31 May 2026 (Tentative)
  • Admit Card Available : 21 May 2026
  • Result Declared : 16 June 2026
  • Counseling  Begin : June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 1650/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 850/-
  • With Late Fee General, OBC, EWS : 2000/-
  • With Late Fee SC, ST : 1000/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
